entities.name: Gilbert Saboya Sunyé
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gilbert Saboya Sunyé is an Andorran economist and politician. He was the minister of Foreign Affairs to the Principality of Andorra from 2011 to 2017. Previously, he was the president of the Committee of Ministers of the Council of Europe from 9 November 2012 until 16 May 2013. From 23 March 2015 until 1 April 2015 he was acting prime minister of Andorra.
